summary: Open 3D tusk meshes exist on MorphoSource for Loxodonta, a Mammuthus primigenius cranium with tusks, and several Mammut species, but the American mastodon (Mammut americanum) tusk items returned are restricted mandibular CT series and no repository holds extracted centerlines or spiral parameters; completeness of each tusk is not recorded.
